_comment: Register sportsdata-mcp with Claude Code. Easiest: `claude mcp add sportsdata -- uvx sportsdata-mcp` (add `-e SPORTSDATA_MCP_GROUPS=...` to pick groups). Or merge the block below into .mcp.json at your project root (project-scoped) — it runs the server via uvx with no install and enables a cross-bookie set. Run `sportsdata-mcp list-groups` for all groups; point SPORTSDATA_MCP_CONFIG at a YAML file for per-provider rate limits, secrets, and premium auth (see examples/sportsdata-mcp.yaml).
